_header: This fixture pins the EXACT ssh argv `shed attach` produces for the plain-tmux
paths (plan 022 C3). It is the tmux FLOOR: plan 022 C5 makes `shed attach`
roost-native, but with no local roost, or with --tmux, or with SHED_ATTACH=tmux,
the produced argv must stay byte-identical to what is pinned here.
Recorded against the pre-roost-native attach.go (commit 1e38346, before any S6
execSSH seam (var execSSH = syscall.Exec in attach.go) to capture argv instead of
exec'ing. HOME is pinned to /home/tester in the test so GetKnownHostsPath()'s
If a future change to the tmux floor path makes this go red, the fix is almost
always in that new code, not in this fixture -- do not 'fix' it without first
confirming the floor is still meant to behave identically to today.

scenarios.name: default_session
scenarios.doc: attach <name> with no flags: default session, tmux new-session -A

scenarios.name: empty_landing_dir_falls_back_to_home
scenarios.doc: a shed whose LandingDir is empty (older server, or a shed with no project dir) must fall back to /home/shed -- NOT to an empty -c ''

scenarios.name: named_session
scenarios.doc: -S/--session debug: a named session, still tmux new-session -A

scenarios.name: new_forces_plain_new_session
scenarios.doc: --new: tmux new-session WITHOUT -A (force-create, error if exists)

scenarios.name: landing_dir_needs_shell_quoting
scenarios.doc: a landing dir containing a single quote and a space must survive shellQuoteArg's escaping
